newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi beheads man for beating woman to death.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads man for beating woman to death.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Wednesday beheaded a Saudi man for killing a woman by beating her head against the ground, the Saudi Interior Ministry said.

A statement carried by the official Saudi Press Agency said Awad bin Mohammad al-Yami was executed in the southwestern city of Najran after a court found him guilty of murdering Rabiya bint Hussein Suwadi.
It did not specify their relationship.
The execution raised to 27 the number of people put to death in the conservative Islamic kingdom this year.
Saudi Arabia enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, drug smugglers, rapists and other criminals.
